title: Interactive Marimo Notebook
text:
Marimo is a reactive Python notebook that runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. Unlike traditional notebooks, when you change a value, all dependent cells automatically update!



 





Reactive Programming: Change a slider, and the plot automatically updates
No Backend Required: Everything runs in your browser via WebAssembly
Edit & Run: Click any cell to edit the code and see results immediately
Standard Libraries: Uses numpy, matplotlib, and other Python libraries
GitHub Pages Ready: Works perfectly on static hosting





Interact: Move the slider in the notebook above
Watch: The sine wave plot automatically updates
Edit: Click any code cell to modify it
Run: Changes execute instantly in your browser

All computation happens locally in your browser - no server needed!
